title: KDS-02 heal HOLDS — catch(HttpException) precedes catch(Exception) in all 4 methods; real 403 is NOT flattened to 422
reproduction: Read controller: index (l.37-43), changeStatus (l.51-55), orderItems (l.62-66), historyToday (l.82-86), recall (l.124-128) all order catch(HttpException) -> response($e->getStatusCode()) BEFORE catch(Exception) -> 422. The service layer mirrors it: changeStatus() rethrows HttpException (KitchenDisplaySystemOrderService.php:494) and recall() uses abort(403/409/422) which the controller preserves.
evidence: PHPUnit tests/Feature/Kds/KdsControllerHttpExceptionPreservedTest.php 6/6 PASS: 'index preserves http exception status instead of flattening to 422', 'order items preserves...', 'history today preserves...', plus 'still flattens plain exception to 422' negatives. No path observed that collapses a 403/throttle to 422.

title: OSS-01 heal HOLDS — list() .catch toast gated behind authBranchId()>0; public wall suppresses, attended fires
reproduction: list() (l.415-433): on dispatch reject, loading cleared then `if (this.authBranchId() > 0) alertService.error(...)`. authBranchId() (l.187-206) coerces store getters to int, defaults 0 (public wall).
evidence: Vitest ossPublicWallErrorToastGatingRuntime.spec.js 3/3 PASS — RUNTIME execution of the real .catch (mutation-resistant to a <=0 vs >0 inversion): public wall (<=0) SUPPRESSES alertService.error; attended (>0) FIRES once with backend message; i18n fallback 'message.something_wrong' when no backend message. ossPublicWallErrorToastGating.spec.js 2/2 PASS. Mirrors the same gating used by _playReadySound (l.366) and audio-unlock wiring (l.146).

title: Bump/release guard is robust — UNPAID order cannot be bumped; optimistic lock prevents double-bump
reproduction: changeStatus() runs in DB::transaction with lockForUpdate (l.399-402). Guards in order: cross-branch 403 (l.405), optimistic-lock 409 if locked.status != expected_status (l.411-423), state-machine canTransition+OrderStateMachine::allows 422 (l.430-435), board-release guard orderIsReleasedForBoard 422 (l.447-449). UNPAID delivery / UNPAID non-cash POS = invisible in list() AND non-bumpable. PENDING_COUNTER + POS-cash stay bumpable (Plan B).
evidence: KitchenReleaseRule is SSOT: list() uses applyBoardReleaseFilter (SQL), changeStatus() uses orderIsReleasedForBoard (in-memory) — same definition so visible==bumpable. PHPUnit KdsUnreleasedOrderBumpP1Test: 'unpaid delivery order is blocked from bump' + 'unpaid non cash pos order is blocked from bump' PASS. (3 happy-path tests in that file fail ONLY on missing X-Idempotency-Key header — pre-existing harness baseline affecting 33 project tests, NOT a heal regression; the guard logic is exercised by the passing block-assertions.)
fix_proposal: None for the guard. Backlog (test-infra, not prod): KdsUnreleasedOrderBumpP1Test happy-path cases should set withHeader('X-Idempotency-Key', ...) so the 202 path is reachable; otherwise they assert the idempotency-middleware 422, masking the real guard.

title: OSS list() lacks the KDS board-release payment filter (theoretical cross-surface mismatch — NOT reachable)
reproduction: OSS list() filters order_type IN (KIOSK,TAKEAWAY) AND status IN (PREPARING,PREPARED) with NO payment-release predicate, whereas KDS list() additionally applies KitchenReleaseRule::applyBoardReleaseFilter (PAID|PENDING_COUNTER|POS-cash). In principle an UNPAID PREPARING kiosk order would show on the OSS wall but be hidden on KDS.
evidence: DB probe on foodking_e2e (php artisan tinker): 104 PREPARING/PREPARED kiosk+takeaway orders, ALL payment_status=5 (PAID); divergent (OSS-visible AND KDS-release-hidden) count = 0. Defended-by-construction: an order only reaches PREPARING via the KDS bump, which enforces orderIsReleasedForBoard (service l.447) — an UNPAID order cannot be bumped to PREPARING, so it can never appear as PREPARING on OSS either. queue_number + order_serial_no are read from the same DB columns by both KDSOrderDetailsResource (l.23/49) and CDS/PosShortcut resources -> no numeric transform, no token/number mismatch.
fix_proposal: Optional defense-in-depth (V1.0.2, not blocking): add KitchenReleaseRule::applyBoardReleaseFilter to OrderStatusScreenOrderService::list()/listForBranch() so the two surfaces share one release definition even if a future path mutates status without going through the KDS bump. Zero behaviour change on current data.
